ucm_spawn_child = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes ucm_spawn_age_value < var:ucm_target.age }
	effect = { while = { count = ucm_spawn_count_value ucm_spawn_create_effect = { DYNASTY = none } scope:ucm_new = { if = { limit = { root.var:ucm_target = { is_female = yes } } set_mother = root.var:ucm_target } else = { set_father = root.var:ucm_target } if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.primary_spouse root.var:ucm_target = { is_female = yes } } set_father = root.var:ucm_target.primary_spouse } else_if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.primary_spouse } set_mother = root.var:ucm_target.primary_spouse } if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.house } set_house = root.var:ucm_target.house } } } }
}

ucm_spawn_sibling = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes OR = { exists = var:ucm_target.father exists = var:ucm_target.mother } }
	effect = { while = { count = ucm_spawn_count_value ucm_spawn_create_effect = { DYNASTY = none } scope:ucm_new = { if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.father } set_father = root.var:ucm_target.father } if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.mother } set_mother = root.var:ucm_target.mother } if = { limit = { exists = root.var:ucm_target.house } set_house = root.var:ucm_target.house } } } }
}

ucm_spawn_parent = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes ucm_spawn_age_value > var:ucm_target.age OR = { AND = { has_character_flag = ucm_spawn_female NOT = { exists = var:ucm_target.mother } } AND = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ucm_spawn_female } NOT = { exists = var:ucm_target.father } } } }
	effect = { ucm_spawn_create_effect = { DYNASTY = generate } if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ucm_spawn_female } var:ucm_target = { set_mother = scope:ucm_new } } else = { var:ucm_target = { set_father = scope:ucm_new } } }
}
